propositions: Core reconciler modules pass transport/client parameters without type annotations or with unresolvable shim imports (rebar_reconciler._backend), causing mypy to widen them to Any and lose enforcement

Relative imports within reconciler modules restore mypy's ability to resolve TicketTransport and check attribute access; shim imports via sys.path injection remain invisible to mypy despite ignore_missing_imports setting

Four capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map) carried as metaclass attributes are not visible to mypy's Protocol attribute collection, so call sites require narrowing to composed capability Protocols

The custom _TransportPortMeta metaclass does not prevent attribute checking when the port type is properly resolved; the observed blindness in prior measurements was caused by unresolvable import paths, not the metaclass itself
